title: Tiny table, more like large footstool
text: Tiny table, more like large footstool. Table is much smaller than expected. Very small.. Wood is NAKED..you cannot wipe it, you will get splinters.  Very pretty though. One panel is already loose...not too heavy.  Easy assembly. All in all,  not worth the price,  although handmade, craftsmanship is sloppy.. I have to go buy sealer because you cannot place anything on naked wood..WEIRD!

The coffee table is handmade of solid reclaimed wood which is solid, durable and beautiful, and has the characteristics of different woods like sheesham, teak, mango wood, acacia, recycled wood, hard wood, etc.
